text:
sasha: Heads up — we need to decide whether rollout/lease visibility is client-visible or strictly internal. Quick thread to capture tradeoffs.

maria: my instinct is to surface the smallest useful piece so SDKs can back off gracefully. e.g. `lease_ttl_seconds` and an optional `soft_expire_at`.

aj: agree with exposing minimal TTL. exposing owner/affinity/internal routing metadata feels risky from both security and ops perspectives.

devon: big caveat: caches. if clients see TTL and start aggressive caching we can break rollouts. need guidance in SDKs (no infinite caching).

sasha: proposal: add `client_visible: boolean` at rollout-level. if true, only emit `lease_ttl_seconds` and `grace_policy_hint` to clients. everything else remains internal.

maria: i like `grace_policy_hint` as a small enum: `failover | fallback | degrade`. keeps payload tiny and actionable.

aj: tiny payload pls. also include `client_hint_url` pointing to docs instead of bulking the message with rules. e.g. `client_hint_url: https://docs.redwood.ai/rollouts#client-hints`

ops-bot: deployment note: must be backwards compatible. schema v1 clients should ignore new fields; Dedicated clusters need a staged migration to stop emitting internals before v2 rollout.

devon: ops question — default behavior? I suggest default `client_visible=false` and tenants can opt-in via console/tenant config. that reduces accidental leakage. also log toggles for audit.

sasha: agree on opt-in default. also: runtime should redact if deployment is Private/VPC unless explicitly enabled by tenant admin.

kate: edge case: customers routing traffic through API gateways that strip headers/metadata. confirm how SDKs will surface these hints to apps (headers vs embedded JSON).

maria: implementation note for SDKs: prefer in-body metadata in a small `rollout_hint` field in the JSON response rather than headers. easier to avoid gateway stripping.

aj: draft RFC checklist i'll own: 1) new `client_visible` flag, 2) `lease_ttl_seconds` + `grace_policy_hint`, 3) `client_hint_url`, 4) opt-in tenant toggle, 5) migration steps for Dedicated/Private. i'll include example payloads: 

```
{
  "rollout_id": "r-2026-03",
  "client_visible": true,
  "lease_ttl_seconds": 30,
  "grace_policy_hint": "fallback",
  "client_hint_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/rollouts#client-hints"
}
```


devon: ops will draft migration plan (how to flip emission, telemetry checks for old clients, canary rollout).

sasha: thanks all. action items: aj -> RFC draft by EOD Thursday; devon -> migration plan; maria -> SDK examples showing conservative caching; kate -> confirm gateway behavior with infra teams. i'll follow up in next sync. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: noted — creating tracking ticket #INF-4123 for RFC + migration tasks.
